notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block and kill Phantom Steed.
easyPrerequisites: Skullwinder is exiled by Phantom Steed.
description:
Cast Time Stretch by paying its mana cost, causing you to take two extra turns after this one
Declare Phantom Steed as an attacker. It triggers, creating a token copy of Skullwinder that's tapped and attacking.
When the Skullwinder token enters, it triggers, returning Time Stretch from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat during your second extra turn.
